title: Business Central 2026 release wave 2 (BC29): Set up vendor-specific number series for self-billing invoices
summary: Business Central 2026 release wave 2 (BC29) adds vendor-specific number series for self-billed purchase invoices. Organizations can now define and assign dedicated numbering sequences per vendor to comply with supplier-specific invoicing requirements and reduce manual errors.
key_points: Define unique number series for individual vendors in self-billing arrangements
Automatically apply vendor-specific numbering when creating self-billed invoices
Maintain separate invoice sequences across different suppliers
Improve compliance with vendor agreements and local numbering requirements
features: Vendor-specific number series for self-billing invoices

quotes.text: You can define and assign dedicated number series for self-billed purchase invoices on a per-vendor basis.
quotes.why_it_matters: Shows the core capability to customize numbering by vendor, enabling compliance with supplier-specific requirements

quotes.text: If 'Self-Billing Agreement' is not enabled, you cannot set 'Self-Billing Invoice Nos.'
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the built-in validation control that ensures vendor-specific numbering is only used when appropriate
